create_InputAudioBufferAppend: create an InputAudioBufferAppend model with base64-encoded PCM16 audio data
create_InputAudioBufferCommit: create an InputAudioBufferCommit model to process the accumulated audio buffer
create_SessionUpdate: create a SessionUpdate model to configure session parameters with an optional model name
create_SessionCreated: create a SessionCreated model with auto-generated session id and timestamp
create_TranscriptionDone: create a TranscriptionDone model with complete transcription text and optional usage info
create_ErrorEvent: create an ErrorEvent model with an error message and optional error code
